[5:18p.m.] #VI #VictoriaIsland #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is quite good in and out of VI, regardless of the high influx of vehicles.

- Ozumba inwards Bonny Camp though on the high side is good; Ozumba inwards Law School and Adetokunbo Ademola is on the high side.

- Akin Adesola is on the high side as well.

- Ahmadu Bello Way is good, though slow at Eko Hotel Roundabout.

- Adeola Odeku is on the high side as well. 

- Ajose Adeogun is good, just a bit slow at the Eko Hotel Roundabout.

data.raw_text:
TEN Tokenomics Explained.

TEN Protocol’s Ethereum L2 drops a 1B token supply bombshell:
🔹 13.87% circulating
🔹 86.13% locked

This isn’t pump & dump territory, it’s a stability first play to keep value steady while building. Thoughts?

> Those slick visuals aren’t just for show. 

@tenprotocol is powered by TEEs for confidential smart contracts.

Backed by MIT research (Cramer et al., 2015), secure multi party computation = a privacy leap for Ethereum.
Scaling with secrecy? That’s next level.

> Fresh from The Manila Time:
TEN’s raise via Legion was community first equal access, zero insider allocations.

This flips the L2 narrative from VC heavy launches to user owned networks.

Could this be the adoption catalyst? 

> Journal of Cryptocurrency (2023) found:
Tokenomics with > 80% vesting cut early stage volatility by 18%.

TEN’s breakdown:
43%+ to community

6% rewards (50% instantly unlocked)
This is a slow release growth engine but will demand outpace the unlocks? 

> My take?
TEN’s merging hard tech (privacy + scalability) with smart economics.
No live network yet, but the blueprint screams long game.

So, are you bullish, cautious, or waiting for mainnet?

Your call. 🔟/🔟
